messages:
zoe-ux: Dropping a short thread for the compact roles + invite UX. Main asks: copy tweaks for SSO badges, whether overrides should be inline or modal, keyboard nav for compact rows, and audit deeplink behavior.

ravi-eng: From infra: compact rows are fine but ensure each visible control has a stable tab target. We should avoid hidden interactive elements that appear on hover; they break keyboard users.

olivia-security: Security requirements: any SSO policy change must emit an audit event with prior_value, new_value, actor_id. Admin-level role changes should require an explicit checkbox in the confirm flow. Also avoid tiny icons as the only indicator of inheritance.

zoe-ux: Copy idea for badges: expanded view uses "SSO: Organization-managed" or "SSO: Overridden (role)"; compact view shortens to "Org" / "Override" with aria-labels. Avoid color-only signals.

tom-pm: Product preference: prefer modal override (safer) unless usability testing shows significant friction. Modal should show count of affected users and a confirmation checkbox for admin roles. Add deep-link from the modal to audit with prefilled filters.

ravi-eng: Dev note: we'll add an API field effective_sso and return affected_users_count when opening the modal. Audit deep-links should be tokenized: /audit?token=abc123 so we don't leak IDs. Server resolves token -> params and enforces rate-limits.

zoe-ux: Keyboard microflow: Enter on row opens quick panel, Escape closes, Arrow Up/Down moves focus between rows. If panel open, focus traps inside. Also respect prefers-reduced-motion for any animations.

a11y-bot: Checklist: [x] aria-labels for badges, [ ] verify tab order with keyboard tests, [x] reduced-motion respected, [ ] screen reader announcement for policy changes.

olivia-security: Audit deeplink content: include event types (sso_change, role_assignment) and a default 30-day window. Make the deeplink copyable so support can paste it into tickets.

tom-pm: Decision: modal override by default. Zoe will update comps with badge text, modal copy, and keyboard appendix. Ravi will implement tokenized deeplinks + audit events. Olivia will confirm audit fields. Rollout behind feature flag for compact mode.
\eoz: Thanks all ":sparkles:". Will post updated frames later today.
